query:
Oh man, I swear the community garden plot I’ve been tending all spring is out to test every last bit of my patience this week. I showed up yesterday morning thinking I’d just pull a few quick weeds and harvest the handful of cherry tomatoes that were finally blushing red, only to find that a family of squirrels had chewed straight through the trellis I built for my sugar snap peas, knocked over three of my potted basil starts, and left half-eaten strawberry tops scattered all across the corner where I planted wildflower seeds for the local bees. I stood there for a good five minutes holding my little harvest basket just staring at the mess, trying not to laugh because honestly, the squirrels around here are so bold they’ll sit on the park bench right next to you and beg for pretzel bites like they pay rent in the neighborhood. I spent nearly two hours after work yesterday retying the pea vines, repotting the basil, and rigging up this silly janky contraption made of old aluminum pie plates and twine that’s supposed to spin in the wind and scare them off, so I’m really hoping that works long enough for me to get at least one full salad out of my plot this summer.
Hey, I’m grabbing drinks from the beverage section right now, can you help me find something? I need a pick-me-up that’s a source of vitamins, and oh, it has to have that official non-GMO project verified seal on the bottle, yeah? Also I don’t want to go over a bill, y’know? I’ve been cutting back on sweet stuff lately so make sure it fits that, thanks.
